steps.title: Initial positions
steps.rule: Go to 7m south of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 5m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 5m north of the centre.

steps.title: Tether pre position
steps.cue: A tether lands on another player
steps.rule: Read the strat's TetherPrePosition: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: ArmHandedness).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Read the strat's TetherPrePosition: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: PlayerMonitorRole).

CasterDps.rule: Read the strat's TetherPrePosition: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: PlayerMonitorRole).

steps.title: Fist resolve slots
steps.rule: Read the strat's FistResolveSlots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: EyeSpawn).

ShieldHealer.rule: Read the strat's FistResolveSlots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: PlayerMonitorIndex).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Read the strat's FistResolveSlots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: PlayerMonitorIndex).

MainTank.rule: Read the strat's FistResolveSlots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: BeyondDefenseTarget).

OffTank.rule: Depends on EyeSpawn: North → W 10m; South → E 10m.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Read the strat's FistResolveSlots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: PlayerMonitorIndex).

steps.title: Tether resolve step
steps.rule: Go to 10m east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: If you are in FarWorldRole: Go to 10m west of the centre; otherwise: Go to 10m east of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 10m west of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 10m west of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Read the strat's TetherResolveStep: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Go to 10m west of the centre.

steps.title: Hyper pulse bait arms
steps.rule: Read the strat's HyperPulseBaitArms: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: ArmHandedness).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Read the strat's HyperPulseBaitArms: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: PlayerMonitorRole).

PhysRangedDps.rule: Read the strat's HyperPulseBaitArms: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NearWorldRole).

steps.title: Hyper pulse dodge
steps.rule: Read the strat's HyperPulseDodge: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: ArmHandedness).

MainTank.rule: Read the strat's HyperPulseDodge: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: BeyondDefenseTarget).

PhysRangedDps.rule: Read the strat's HyperPulseDodge: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NearWorldRole).

steps.title: Monitor positions
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: Read the strat's MonitorPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: PlayerMonitorIndex).

OffTank.rule: Read the strat's MonitorPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: EyeSpawn).

RegenHealer.rule: Read the strat's MonitorPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: FarWorldRole).

ShieldHealer.rule: Read the strat's MonitorPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: ArmHandedness).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Read the strat's MonitorPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: OmegaMonitorSide).

PhysRangedDps.rule: Read the strat's MonitorPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: PlayerMonitorRole).

MeleeDpsB.rule: Read the strat's MonitorPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show.

CasterDps.rule: Read the strat's MonitorPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NearWorldTetherIndex).

steps.title: Monitor adjustment
steps.rule: Stand near waymark B, 15m east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Read the strat's MonitorAdjustment: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: SwivelCannonSide).

ShieldHealer.rule: Read the strat's MonitorAdjustment: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark D, 12m west of the centre.

steps.title: Swivel dodge
steps.rule: Read the strat's SwivelDodge: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: ArmHandedness).

steps.title: Rescue unsafe
steps.rule: Read the strat's RescueUnsafe: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show.

MainTank.rule: Go to 10m west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 10m east of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 10m east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Go to 10m west of the centre.

steps.title: Return to middle
steps.rule: Read the strat's ReturnToMiddle: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: ArmHandedness).

MainTank.rule: Read the strat's ReturnToMiddle: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: OmegaMonitorSide).

OffTank.rule: Read the strat's ReturnToMiddle: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: PlayerMonitorIndex).

ShieldHealer.rule: Read the strat's ReturnToMiddle: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: OmegaMonitorSide).

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on OmegaMonitorSide: Right → N 7m; Left → S 6m.

steps.title: Tank forward
steps.rule: Depends on OmegaMonitorSide: Right → S 8m; Left → N 8m.

steps.title: Break last tether
steps.rule: Read the strat's BreakLastTether: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: OmegaMonitorSide).

MainTank.rule: Go to 5m north-west of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Depends on OmegaMonitorSide: Right → NW 5m; Left → SE 5m.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Read the strat's BreakLastTether: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show.

CasterDps.rule: Read the strat's BreakLastTether: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 5m north-east of the centre.
